changes: Keep bright-red saturation checks; allow shadow R=64..144, R-G>=32, R-B>=16 and R>=1.25*G/B
Three consistent frames required to acquire; preserve association for at most two misses, but never output a valid red result on a miss
Main FPGA/MCU and 320x180 full-pixel input unchanged
test_semantics: 0x44 was previously a negative dark-warm test. Hardware diagnostics indicate the failing target occupies this dark red/brown RGB332 range, so it is now explicitly tested as positive shadow_red. Bright 0xac remains a negative warm-color test. Real background test is required; RGB332 alone cannot universally distinguish dark red from brown.
